title: Tool Length Measurement — Out of Tolerance
description: In-process tool length measurement via touch probe reports P023 = {val} mm offset from stored value. Tolerance ±0.05 mm. Tool slot {val2}. Risk of dimensional error on workpiece.
probable_cause: Tool not fully seated, incorrect tool loaded, or tool breakage not detected by P002 load monitor.
diagnostic_steps: Inspect tool in spindle for seating
Verify tool ID matches NC program expectation
remedy: Re-seat tool and re-measure. If offset confirmed, update tool table and scrap/inspect last part.
required_action: Stop current operation. Machine must be inspected before resuming production.
escalation_path: If TCS-MJ-002 is not addressed (stop current operation. machine must be inspected before resuming production.), the fault will escalate in this order: SPN-MJ-003, then TCS-CR-001. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
